title: Untitled (Diptych with Targets) 6
description: Two framed collages displayed side by side against a grey wall, photographed as an installation pair. Each work centers a large white rectangular field bordered by layered mixed-media elements including bullseyes, vinyl records, geometric shapes, and sports imagery in red, black, white, ochre, and blue.
composition: paired framed works flanking central white fields
keywords: bullseye vinyl record sports motif collage
